title: Small BiZOOness Saturday: Holiday Open House
seo_title: Small BiZOOness Saturday Holiday Open House, Springfield
description: This holiday open house at Wildlife Zooniversity, the Dickerson Park Zoo education building, lets you meet Santa and get a holiday photo, meet ambassador animals, and do a Christmas craft for kids. You can get $10 off when you get, give or renew a FOZ membership (with a zoo ornament while supplies last) and find discounts on zoo education camps and classes. It runs Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM in Springfield, MO.
venue: 1103 W Smith St, Springfield, MO 65803, United States
